detail.longDescription: "Two critical flaws hidden for years in PHP, a technology that powers much of the web, have sparked a global cybersecurity scramble. Governments, hospitals and businesses rushed to patch vulnerable systems after researchers uncovered weaknesses that could allow attackers to gain access to servers and databases. Tarah Wheeler, an information security executive, AI researcher and chief security officer at TPO Group, joins DW News to explain why the discovery is causing alarm, whether hackers are already trying to exploit the flaws, and what it tells us about AI's growing role in cybersecurity." https://www. youtube.com/watch?v=3EB16ZFkRhw # CyberSecurity # PHP # PHP2Shell # AI # GenerativeAI # LLMs # Programming # SoftwareDevelopment
